editorial:
You know that feeling when work and family collide during the holidays? That's exactly what Rebecca faces in this cozy romance. She's tasked with throwing the company holiday party, but there's a catch: she has to plan it with Chris, her office rival. To make things even trickier, the party lands right in the middle of Hanukkah, so Rebecca is juggling work deadlines, family traditions, and a guy she can't stand. The vibe is warm and festive, with plenty of bickering that slowly turns into something sweeter. It's the kind of movie you put on when you want comfort, laughs, and a little holiday magic without anything too heavy.

The chemistry between the leads carries the whole thing, and the holiday setting feels genuine rather than forced. On the downside, the plot follows a pretty predictable path, and some side characters don't get much to do. Still, if you enjoy enemies-to-lovers stories with a seasonal twist, this one delivers. It's perfect for a cozy night in with hot cocoa. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for your collection.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Rebecca and Chris pull off the holiday party, and their arguing gives way to a real connection. The twist comes when Rebecca realizes Chris has been quietly supporting her family traditions all along, even learning about Hanukkah to make her feel included. He surprises her with a thoughtful gesture showing he truly cares. They share a sweet moment under the holiday lights, and Rebecca chooses to embrace both her work and her heart. They end up together, proving your biggest rival can become your greatest love.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves enemies-to-lovers holiday romances
